proposition.claim:
The asserted Gaussian limit for any bounded input vectors and strictly smaller uniform GDP parameter do not hold over the full L2 ball.

Expected descent is reported as an unqualified pathwise gradient bound; local-optimum and worker-growth wording is stronger than justified.

repair.content:
Restrict and justify the asymptotic theorem or provide valid worst-case accounting; specify adjacency, clipping, sampling, noise scales and finite composition; recalibrate comparisons.

Restore expectations or prove a confidence bound, distinguish stationary from locally optimal, state lower worker growth, keep variance/std notation consistent and expose constants/dimension.
